findings.title: Information Leakage: workspace projection hidden in source rewrite
findings.why_it_matters: The effective partnership_workspace definition is assembled by replacing a string in the prior migration's function body. A later change to that function can miss these fields or make this migration fail on a text marker, while the SQL source no longer shows the actual deployed definition. Declaring the updated function explicitly gives maintainers one inspectable version and keeps the existing visibility predicates reviewable.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the pg_get_functiondef/replace/EXECUTE block with an explicit CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION partnership_workspace definition that includes study and grantedPermissions in its return object; preserve the previous function's visibility, released-version, consent, and document predicates verbatim, then rerun the database fixture tests.
evidence: harness/migrations/20261020-partnership-intake.sql:154 -- definition:=pg_catalog.replace(definition,'''studyTitle'',s.config->>''title''','''studyTitle'',s.config->>''title'',''study'',pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(''id'',s.id,''status'',s.status,''revision'',s.revision,''config'',s.config),''grantedPermissions'',COALESCE((SELECT pg_catalog.to_jsonb(m.permissions) FROM research_private.memberships m WHERE m.study_id=s.id AND m.actor_ref=p.actor_ref),''[]''::jsonb)');
